description: Public service of Phnom Penh water supply authority is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This is the combined dataset of public services served by Phnom Penh Water Supply Authority such as connection fee and tariff fee. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Infrastructure, Water and sanitation infrastructure and facilities. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2020-03-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
